answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the pigment of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the trellis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the kernel of the next round. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing.
